senses.gloss: הִשְׁכִּים (b. h.; [to load, v. Ges. Thes. s. v.,] to rise early; to do a thing early.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 30a:12">Ber. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ לצאת לדרך</he> if one rises early (before sunrise) to go on the road; <cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 3:19">Tosef. ib. III, 19</cite>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:11:1">Cant. R. to V, 11</cite> (play on <he>שחרות כעורב</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:11:1">ib.</cite>; cmp. <cite ref="U00705"><he>שׁחַר</he></cite>) <he>מַשְׁכִּים ומעריב</he> (<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19">Lev. R. s. 19</cite> <he>משחיר</he>), v. <cite ref="P01244"><he>עָרַב</he> II</cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 7:1">B. Mets. VII, 1</cite> if one hired working men, <he>ואמר להן להַשְׁכִּים וכ׳</he> and told them that he expected them to come to their work earlier and go later (than the customary time).
<cite ref="Berakhot 47b:18">Ber. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>לעולם יַשְׁכִּים אדם וכ׳</he> a man should always go early to the house of prayer, that he may succeed in being counted among the earliest ten &c.
<cite ref="Berakhot 16b">Ib. 16ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. IV, 7ᵈ bot. <he>ונַשְׁכִּים ונמצא וכ׳</he> that we may early (in life) obtain &c., v. <cite ref="J00272"><he>יִחוּל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 92b:2">B. Kam. 92ᵇ</cite> <he>הַשְׁכֵּם ואכול</he> take an early breakfast.
<cite ref="Gittin 7a:7">Gitt. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>הַשְׁכֵּם והערב עליהן והם וכ׳</he> (omit <he>לבה״מ</he>) pray against them (the tormentors) early and late, and they shall cease of themselves; a. fr.—
Bicc. III, 2 ולִמַשְׁכִּים היה וכ׳ and at rising time &c.
